Hours worked, counting each hour equally
value: Nets entries, exits, and moves between full-time and part-time work.
Values those changes at each parent’s own wage. Entrants earn about 40% of the national average; parents cutting hours tend to earn more than entrants.
Adds earnings from accumulated experience and retained employment, which account for about a tenth of the total in 2030.
